32:5 , serpent 3:1 , ass Num 22:28 , horse הֶאָח יאֹמַר Job 39:25 etc.; inanimate things, personified 28:14 compare 28:22 etc.; so in allegory or fable Judg 9:8 ; 2Kin 14:9 etc.; especially in narration, וַיּאֹמֶר etc., Gen 4:6 + very often): mostly followed by thing said, either substantive Jer 14:17 (c. clause app.) Deut 27:16 f.; Judg 12:6 ; pronoun Gen 44:16 ; 2Kin 20:14 +; or (usually) clause Gen 1:3 ; 3:1 ; 37:20 + often ( oratio recta [direct speech]); with adverb thus, so 32:5 ; Num 20:14 ; 1Kin 20:3 , 5 + often; especially י אָמַר ׳כֹּה Exod 5:1 ; 7:17 ; 8:1 ; 8:20 ; 1Chr 17:4 + often; the person addressed usually introduced by אֶל Gen 3:1 ; 15:7 ; 22:7 ; Lev 21:1 ; 2Sam 3:7 ; 1Kin 12:5 , 23 , or לְ Gen 3:13 ; 4:15 ; 1Sam 20:2 ; 2Sam 2:21 ; 1Kin 14:2 + often; rarer combinations are, ׳א בְּאָזְנֵי Isa 49:20 (compare 5:9 & see דבר ); ׳א לִפְנֵי Ezek 28:9 ; ׳א לְעֵינֵי Deut 31:7 ; Josh 10:12 ; Jer 28:11 ; ׳א בְּ Joel 2:17 ; Psa 126:2 , where בְּ local; in all cases usually followed by direct object of words said, Exod 19:25 being very singular; Gen 4:8 the object-clause has probably fallen out, compare Vrss Di; = mention, name, designate 22:2-3 , 43:27 , 29 ; Exod 32:13 ; Num 14:40 ; 1Sam 10:16 ; 16:3 ; 2Sam 6:22 ; Neh 6:19 ; compare Psa 139:20 לִמְזִמָּה יֹמְרוּךָ speak of thee for falsehood (but many, as Hup Pe Dy Che, read יַמְרוּךָ ); = tell, declare, proclaim , (followed by direct object only) 40:11 ; Ezek 13:7 ; in reply to question = answer Exod 12:27 ; Josh 4:7 ; 1Kin 9:9 ; Jer 5:19 ; 22:9 .
